parameters.name: DeliveryOssBucketName
parameters.description: The name of the OSS bucket.

parameters.name: DeliveryOssEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the delivery of template execution records to OSS. Default value: false.

parameters.name: DeliveryOssKeyPrefix
parameters.description: The directory of the OSS bucket, such as "oos/execution". Set this parameter to an empty string ("") if no directory is required. If a directory was previously configured and you want to clear it, pass an empty string ("").

parameters.name: DeliverySlsEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the delivery of template execution records to Simple Log Service. Default value: false.

parameters.name: DeliverySlsProjectName
parameters.description: The name of the Simple Log Service project.
